title: AI shopping and costlier parts: we must fix checkout and pricing
summary: NRF: half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI. ChatGPT Wallet and Klarna in Adyen enable agent purchases; Target reports an AI sales lift. PCB shortage lasts to mid-2028; notebook shipments stay weak to Q2 2027.

points.headline: Agent checkout is live, so our catalog and payments must be agent-ready
points.detail: ChatGPT Wallet buys from merchants via its Dots agent; Klarna joined Adyen’s agentic suite; NRF says half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI. We should make feeds, pages and financing agent-readable.

points.headline: Component shortages are lifting prices while notebook demand stays soft
points.detail: PCB relief is not seen before mid-2028; European notebook revenue rose 16% on pricier models while units fell; shipments stay weak to Q2 2027. We should plan inventory, pricing and promotions together.

points.headline: Retailers are winning with AI assistants and fast delivery
points.detail: Target’s Ask Target assistant shows an early sales lift in beta; Walmart U.S. e-commerce grew 23% on fulfillment speed. We should test guided shopping and match delivery promises.

points.headline: Small-business holiday spending is a window for business offers
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spending. We should push business bundles, financing and bulk offers in our store.
